definitions.gloss: chairperson; director; president (of a board or organization)
definitions.explanation: The head of a board of directors or governing body of an organization such as a foundation, association, school corporation, or similar institution. Not used for corporate presidents of for-profit companies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{理事長|りじちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new chairperson has taken office.

examples.japanese: {学校法人|がっこうほうじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{理事長|りじちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}した→挨拶する：01797_aisatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The director of the school corporation gave an address.

examples.japanese: ⟦{財団|ざいだん}→財団：11331_zaidan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{理事長|りじちょう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{社会|しゃかい}{貢献|こうけん}→社会貢献：22315_shakaikouken⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: As the foundation's chairperson, I am putting effort into social contribution activities.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{理事|りじ}→理事：13558_riji⟧ (director, trustee — a board member) and {長|ちょう} (head, chief). Refers to the top position on a board of directors in non-profit organizations, educational institutions, and similar bodies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理事長|りじちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to assume the position of chairperson
- {理事長|りじちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as chairperson
- {理事長|りじちょう}⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: chairperson's address/greeting
- {学校法人|がっこうほうじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{理事長|りじちょう}: director of a school corporation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧: president, chairman — used for companies, associations, and other organizations
- ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧: company president — specifically for for-profit companies
- ⟦{理事|りじ}→理事：13558_riji⟧: director, trustee — a board member (not the head)
- ⟦{議長|ぎちょう}→議長：02681_gichou⟧: chairperson — used for meetings, assemblies, and legislative bodies
